pinPolicy.title: PIN pad
pinPolicy.showHelp: Whether the PIN pad is shown and who is at the till is asked. It holds for the whole business: besides, each device decides on its own, above.
pinPolicy.on: Staff choose their name and type their PIN, so every sale carries the name of whoever made it.
pinPolicy.off: Nobody types a PIN. Whoever opened the till in the morning is the name of every sale until the shift ends, whoever made them: you will not know who sold what or who gave a discount. Staff who only have a PIN and no account will not be able to enter.
pinPolicy.againMinutes: A till nobody touches for {n} minutes closes the session and shows the PIN pad: the next sale carries the name of the next person.
pinPolicy.againShift: The PIN pad asks again when the session ends: at the end of the shift or when someone signs out.
pinPolicy.digitsHelp: Everyone types the same number of digits, which is what lets the keypad enter at the last one instead of asking you to confirm. The PINs in use keep working until their owner changes them.
pinPolicy.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change whether it asks.
